Data.Recommendedapproach: Approve the draft as-is; it gives the KB-supported self-service fix and supported Service Desk contact options. No escalation is needed unless Aisha replies that the Company Portal reinstall fails or the queue still does not appear. Verify only whether this is an office FollowMe printing issue and not a warehouse label printer issue, since the KB says label printers are handled by Operations, not IT.
Data.Subject: HomeFix-Print queue disappeared
Data.Body: After the last laptop update the HomeFix-Print queue vanished from my printers list, so I can't badge-print anything. How do I get it back without waiting for a technician?
Data.Rationale: The KB specifically says HomeFix-Print is the FollowMe printing queue installed by default and that if it is missing, users should reinstall “FollowMe Print Queue” from Company Portal. This affects one user’s printing but does not indicate a site outage or total inability to work, so Medium priority is appropriate. Service Desk contact details and staffed hours are supported by the KB.
Data.Draftreply:
Hi Aisha,

I’m sorry the HomeFix-Print queue disappeared after your laptop update. You can get it back yourself without waiting for a technician:

1. Open Company Portal on your company laptop.
2. Reinstall the item named “FollowMe Print Queue.”
3. Once it is installed, print to the queue named “HomeFix-Print.”
4. Badge in at any office printer to release your job. Print jobs are held for 24 hours.

If the queue still does not appear after reinstalling it, please update this ticket or contact the Service Desk through help.homefixsupply.com. You can also call extension 4357 during staffed hours, 06:00–20:00 local time, Monday to Saturday.

Best regards,
HomeFix Supply Support Team
